author: mark
text:
Add to ARCH amendment scope: pin the diagnostic-only rule as a
hard contract in §2.3 (Step on-disk).

Wording (sketch — implementer should refine):

  The harness writes request.json and response.json strictly as
  diagnostic / audit artifacts. These files have no runtime read
  integration anywhere in the harness: messages history is
  assembled in-memory within a single process; replay re-runs the
  context assembler against the snapshot commit's tree; resume is
  scoped to workflow-event boundaries (§1 #4, §603), not mid-
  conversation. The frontend may read them (user inspection).

  This is structural, not advisory: their location at
  <conv-repo>/steps/, outside every worktree, makes context
  assembly (§3.5, §5) physically incapable of including them.

  Tool input/output records (tools/<tool-id>/{input,output}.json)
  are explicitly NOT covered by this rule — tool outputs are
  nondeterministic and the harness reads output.json to build
  tool_result blocks for the next step. They share the
  out-of-worktree path but keep their runtime read.

P2 onward must enforce structurally: no harness code site reads
request.json or response.json.

author: mark
text:
v0.3.1 P1: ARCH amendment for step records out of worktree

Pin the on-disk shape change in ARCHITECTURE.md before any code lands.
Step records relocate to <conv-repo>/steps/<conv-id>/NNN/ — outside
every worktree, untracked by git — which makes them physically excluded
from context assembly by construction (§5.1 worktree invariant).

Key amendments:
- §2.2: directory listing relocates steps/ to conv-repo root; defines
  "step record" and pins the structural exclusion from context.
- §2.3: rewrites Step on-disk layout. New meta.json carries `commit:`
  (branch tip at step-start) — the read state, recoverable by replaying
  the assembler. New Diagnostic-only contract pins request.json /
  response.json as audit artifacts with no runtime read; tool
  input.json / output.json explicitly exempt (runtime-read for
  tool_result framing).
- §2.10: step 1 commits dispatch artifacts; step ≥2 takes no pre-call
  commit (prior tip is the read state).
- §3.5: live-streaming watch path moves to response.json; pin
  tail-f-with-fd-close completion signal (writer closes fd; inotify
  IN_CLOSE_WRITE marks response complete).
- §4.4: pin response.json on-disk shape as JSONL of stream events,
  collapsing the wire-side streaming/non-streaming distinction.
- §5.2: drop steps/** from worker.order example.
- §5.3, v0.3 milestone, PRINCIPLES.md ("Read state per step is a real
  git commit", "File path as hint"): cross-references and examples
  updated to match.

Docs-only. P2-P4 implement the consequences. make ci passes
(fmt-check + lint + 100% coverage).
